Verify its downstream revenue effects and compare them with the durability, retention, and margin quality of the prior pricing result. Start guarded because removing onboarding steps could reduce setup or qualification quality.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified prior result directly addresses the current completion decline and improved completion by 13%, time-to-value by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention by 3%, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because its 18% qualified-revenue lift came with 12% lower retention and failure through the first renewal cycle. Revalidate the onboarding effect in the current environment and monitor retention and qualified revenue, not completion alone.
